name: cf-browser
description: Give Claude Code a real cloud browser on Cloudflare Browser Run: saved logins in an everyday profile, human handoff for logins and 2FA through Live View, a daily budget, and browsers that close themselves so nothing keeps billing.

account_id.title: Cloudflare account ID
account_id.description: The 32-character account ID (dashboard: Account home → the ID next to the account name). Or leave empty and put CF_ACCOUNT_ID in ~/.cf-browser/.env.

api_token.title: Cloudflare API token (Browser Run Edit)
api_token.description: An API token with the Browser Run Edit/Write permission for this account. Stored in the OS keychain. Or leave empty and put CF_API_TOKEN in ~/.cf-browser/.env.

plan.title: Workers plan (paid or free)
plan.description: paid (default) or free. On free the plugin caps idle timeout at 300 s, concurrency at 3 and the daily budget at 9 minutes, matching Cloudflare's free limits.

default_profile.title: Everyday profile
default_profile.description: The profile new browsers load and save logins to by default.

profiles_dir.title: Profiles folder
profiles_dir.description: Where saved logins live. Outside the plugin's data folder on purpose, so uninstalling keeps them; delete the folder to forget every login.

idle_timeout_seconds.title: Close idle browsers after (seconds)
idle_timeout_seconds.description: Idle time is billed, so idle browsers are closed. Cloudflare's own keep_alive is set 60 s longer as a backstop.

max_session_minutes.title: Maximum browser age (minutes)
max_session_minutes.description: A browser is saved and closed at this age (not during a human handoff).

max_concurrent_sessions.title: Maximum open browsers per window
max_concurrent_sessions.description: Cloudflare bills concurrency above 10 (monthly average of daily peaks).

daily_budget_minutes.title: Daily browser-minute budget
daily_budget_minutes.description: New browsers are refused (unless you confirm) once this machine used this many browser-minutes today (UTC).

open_live_view_locally.title: Open Live View in your browser
open_live_view_locally.description: Open Live View and handoff pages in your default browser instead of printing their URL.
